pages.title: Lie Groups
pages.text: $(thing)Lie Groups$()$(br2)Groups of symmetries that turn smoothly, by any amount. The forces of the Standard Model are three of them: U(1), SU(2) and SU(3). Unlocks the Lie Group Lattice.

$(thing)Insight$(): 70$(br2)$(thing)Builds on$(): Groups and Symmetry, Vectors and Matrices, Calculus.$(br2)$(thing)Samples$(): 2 Symmetry Crystal.$(br2)$(thing)Derivation$(): Write the dimension G of the group SU(n), the number of independent ways it can turn.
